title: Python June Meetup: Running Serverless & Data Pipelines with Yaetos
description:
This month we have two awesome sessions on **Serverless** & **Yaetos**:

***

* ➡️ **What:** Run the extra mile with serverless
* 📢 **Who**: [Mohammed Bouabid](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mohammed-bouabid-a326b74a/)
* ⏱ **Duration**: \~30 minutes
* 👅 **Language**: English
* 🧐 **Abstract**: sennder is migration from monolith to microservices. We will explain the requirements and architecture that they're working on, and see some live coding on how to consume Kafka events using AWS Lambda.

***

* ➡️ **What:** Creating Python Data Pipelines with Yaetos
* 📢 **Who**: [Arthur Prevot](https://www.linkedin.com/in/arthurprevot/) (🐦 [@arprevot](https://twitter.com/arprevot))
* ⏱ **Duration**: \~30 minutes
* 👅 **Language**: English
* 🧐 **Abstract**: The talk will describe the challenges of creating python data pipelines and putting them in production in the cloud, and how [Yaetos](https://github.com/arthurprevot/yaetos) can help. It is targeted at data engineers, data scientists, analysts and python enthusiasts. Yaetos is a data framework, simplifying the use of Apache Spark in the AWS cloud, and with implementations in production at Infojobs and The Hotels Network.

***

title: Python Meetup September: AI Goes Back To School
description:
For the month of September, we have two amazing talks about **LLMs** and **RAGs**.
\-\-\-
Schedule:

* 👋 & 🗣️ 18:30: Welcome and Talks
* 🍕 **&** 🍻 20:00: Networking, food and drinks!
* 👋 21:00: Bye!

\-\-\-

* ➡️ **What:** *From text to actions: LLMs as the new software consumers*
* 📢 **Who**: Pol Alvarez Vecino
* ⏱ **Duration**: 30 minutes
* 👅 **Language**: English
* 🧐 **Abstract**: QA bots, copilots, workflow automation - LLMs are evolving to control our software through natural language. The endgame is APIs. LLMs that can convert user intents directly into HTTP requests, like Talk2Apis does today, will have the flexibility to access any service. This creates a machine-first software economy with big implications for developers. Python examples included.

\-\-\-\-

* ➡️ **What:** *Ragtime: An Approach to Retrieval-Augmented Generation*
* 📢 **Who**: Javier Martinez Alcantara
* ⏱ **Duration**: 30 minutes
* 👅 **Language**: English
* 🧐 **Abstract**: In this session, we'll explore a pattern that has sparked significant interest in the world of natural language models (LLMs): Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). We'll walk through a practical implementation, dive into its details, and share insights based on our experiences working with these methods. Whether you're a beginner or an expert, we encourage you to join—what matters most is your interest in LLMs, machine learning, and engineering, and how to leverage these technologies to bring value to your company or organization.

title: Python Meetup June: Summer is already here!
description:
For this month's Meetup, we are going back to the Cibernàrium at Barcelona Activa, hand in hand with **Mobile World Capital**. We will have two talks: one about **Feedback for programming learners** and another one about a **Python-powered security lab**.

\-\-\-
Schedule:

* 18:00: Welcome
* ️ 18:15: Talks
* **&** 20:00: Networking!
* 20:45: Bye!

\-\-\-

* ➡️ **What: Feedback immediat per estudiants de programació: Powered by Python**
* **Who**: Moisès Gómez Girón
* ⏱ **Duration**: 45 minutes
* **Language**: Catalan
* **Abstract**: Presentació d’una eina per a l’ensenyament de la programació, creada per minimitzar el temps entre la resolució de l’exercici i la recepció de la retroacció. L’eina ha estat desenvolupada al llarg dels anys en paral·lel al seu ús a l’aula, sota pressió per terminis ajustats, canvis de temari i estudiants amb imaginació per trobar maneres enginyoses d’enganyar el sistema. El resultat és una història de compromisos i solucions creatives, des de prohibir funcionalitats concretes del llenguatge fins a l’ús exclusiu de tecnologies gratuïtes.
\-\-\-\-
* ➡️ **What: Python-powered Cybersecurity Lab: Caldera, Elastic Stack & ATT&CK simluation**
* **Who**: Mauricio Volcanes
* ⏱ **Duration**: 45 minutes
* **Language**: Spanish
* **Abstract**: En esta charla mostraremos un laboratorio completo de ciberseguridad compuesto por máquinas virtuales, Elastic Stack y el framework MITRE Caldera (Python). A través de una demostración guiada, analizaremos cómo simular técnicas del framework MITRE ATT&CK y cómo correlacionarlas en tiempo real con logs de sistemas Linux para detectar comportamiento malicioso.

\-\-\-\-

title: Pandas Documentation Sprint
description:
> What?

We'll be joining a worldwide event to improve Pandas documentation: https://python-sprints.github.io/pandas/

Pandas is an open source Python library for data manipulation and analysis. Its popularity is skyrocketing, and it is becoming the de-facto standard for data science and data engineering. But the number of core developers and contributors did not grow as fast as its popularity, and things like the API documentation would benefit from some help.

We plan to help leave the API documentation for the Series and DataFrame classes in a perfect state.

> Who?

To join the sprint, you should have some previous knowledge of Pandas, and bring your own laptop. That's it!

The organizers will provide help and coaching with Pandas, doing Pull Requests, setting up the environment, or whatever you need.

We will provide snacks and drinks during the event, including vegan stuff. If you have some food intolerance please let us know in advance so we can prepare.

> How?

Just join the waitlist for this event!

Please, make sure you answer the question when joining. We need to keep a good balance in terms of experience and diversity, and we'll select attendees manually. We have room for about 25 people.
